howToFind.question: How to check who unfollowed you on Instagram without app?
howToFind.answer: Open Meta Accounts Center › Create export › Select your profile › Choose "Export to device" › Select only "Followers and following" › Set format to JSON. Download the ZIP when ready (usually 5-30 minutes), then upload it here. The tool compares your lists in the browser, so the export is never uploaded anywhere. No login needed.

withoutDownload.question: Can I check Instagram unfollowers without data download or apps?
withoutDownload.answer: No. Instagram doesn't provide a native unfollower list. The only safe methods are: (1) Manually checking followed accounts vs followers, or (2) Using your official data download with this tool. This tracker does method 2 for you, free: no password, no login, no account risk.

privacy.question: How does Instagram unfollower tracker work without login?
privacy.answer: This tracker uses your official Instagram data export (ZIP file) to analyze followers locally in your browser. No login required. Parsing, filtering and search all happen on your device, and your Instagram export stays in this browser. We receive only anonymous page analytics, which you can switch off in the footer. This method is safe because it uses Instagram's official export tool, not password scraping.

safety.question: Is it safe to use Instagram unfollower tracker apps?
safety.answer: Yes, if they use your official Instagram data export. Apps requiring your Instagram password violate Terms of Service and pose security risks. Safe trackers use only the ZIP file from Instagram's Data Download tool: no login, no password required. This tool uses that method exclusively.

dataIncluded.question: What data does Instagram include in my data download file?
dataIncluded.answer: The ZIP file contains your profile info, followers list, following list, comments, posts, messages, saved items, and more. For unfollower tracking, the key files are followers_1.json (your followers) and following.json (who you follow). The tracker uses these two files to identify unfollowers and non-mutuals.

zipFile.question: What is Instagram data download and why use it?
zipFile.answer: Instagram Data Download (via Meta Accounts Center) is the official tool for exporting your account information including followers and following lists. It's the only safe, authorized way to access this data without risking your account. Apps that ask for your password violate Instagram's Terms of Service.

htmlExport.question: I exported HTML instead of JSON. Do I need to export again?
htmlExport.answer: No. SafeUnfollow already reads both formats. HTML exports also work, but JSON is the format we read most reliably, so it's still what the guide recommends. Upload the ZIP you already have.

accountSafety.question: Will my Instagram account be safe using this tracker?
accountSafety.answer: Yes, 100% safe. Unlike apps that ask for your password and 'scrape' data (which violates Terms of Service), this tool uses your official data export. No login required: you download the ZIP directly from Instagram, then upload it locally to your browser. We never access your account.

downloadTime.question: How long does it take to receive my Instagram data download?
downloadTime.answer: Meta typically sends your data within 5-30 minutes via email. Larger accounts or high server load may take up to a few hours. Once you have the ZIP, the analysis runs in your own browser rather than on a server, so there is no queue and no upload wait. Bigger exports naturally take longer to read than small ones.

scale.question: What size Instagram account export can you analyze?
scale.answer: This tracker handles exports of up to 1,000,000+ accounts. We use columnar storage and bitset indexing so filtering stays fast as the list grows. Whether you have 100 followers or 1,000,000, the tool stays responsive.

free.question: Are there free Instagram unfollower trackers?
free.answer: Yes. The analysis is 100% free: every badge, filter and account, with no signup and no limit. Most alternatives charge a monthly subscription. Here, the only thing that costs anything is exporting your filtered list as a file — a one-time unlock, never a subscription, with the price shown on the button. Viewing the list here is always free. Open-source (MIT), and your Instagram export is processed locally in your browser.

analyzeData.question: How do I analyze my Instagram data download to find unfollowers?
analyzeData.answer: Upload your Instagram ZIP file to this tracker. The tool unpacks your follower and following lists locally in your browser, compares them, and highlights who unfollowed you. Results show unfollowers, non-mutuals, mutual followers, and more, and the comparison runs on your device rather than on a server.

shareDataSafely.question: Is it safe to upload Instagram data download to third-party tools?
shareDataSafely.answer: Yes, if the app processes your file locally in your browser and keeps it there. This tracker reads your ZIP entirely on your device: the file itself stays in this browser, and only anonymous page analytics ever leave it. Be wary of cloud-based unfollower trackers that ask you to hand over your ZIP or your Instagram password: those send your file to someone else's machine. Always check that the app works from the official export and asks for no login.

withoutPassword.question: How does SafeUnfollow work without my Instagram password?
withoutPassword.answer: SafeUnfollow uses Instagram's official data export feature (available in Meta Accounts Center) instead of your password. You download your follower data as a ZIP file directly from Instagram, then upload that file here. The app reads the JSON files inside the ZIP to compare followers vs following lists. All processing happens in your browser. No API access, no scraping, no login credentials needed.

betterThanPaid.question: Is SafeUnfollow better than paid Instagram unfollow apps?
betterThanPaid.answer: For most users, yes. The analysis is free: no signup, no subscription, every account in your export. It needs no login (so no account ban risk), processes your export locally in your browser (maximum privacy), handles 1,000,000+ accounts (most paid apps cap at 100,000), and is open source. Exporting your filtered list as a file is a one-time unlock — paid once, not every month; everything you can see on screen stays free. Paid apps offer real-time monitoring, which requires API access, but that violates Instagram's Terms of Service and risks your account. SafeUnfollow uses the official, safe data export method.

mobileUse.question: Can I use SafeUnfollow on iPhone or Android?
mobileUse.answer: Yes. SafeUnfollow works in any modern mobile browser (Safari, Chrome, Firefox). Visit safeunfollow.app, upload your ZIP file, and read your results on the phone. You can also install it as a PWA for quick access from your home screen. Most people who use it are on a phone, and the layout is built for that first. Request your data export from the Instagram app, download the ZIP from your email, then upload it here.
